#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Summarize a CSV of build results.

set -euo pipefail

main() {
  local file="${1:-}"

  if [[ -z ${file} ]]; then
    printf 'usage: %s FILE\n' "${0##*/}" >&2
    return 64
  fi

  if [[ ! -r ${file} ]]; then
    printf '%s: cannot read %s\n' "${0##*/}" "${file}" >&2
    return 66
  fi

  local total=0 passed=0 failed=0
  local status

  while IFS=, read -r _ status _; do
    if [[ ${status} == 'status' ]]; then
      continue
    fi
    total=$((total + 1))
    case "${status}" in
      pass) passed=$((passed + 1)) ;;
      *) failed=$((failed + 1)) ;;
    esac
  done < "${file}"

  printf 'total=%d passed=%d failed=%d\n' "${total}" "${passed}" "${failed}"
}

main "$@"

main() {
  local json=0
  local file=""

  while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
    case "$1" in
      --json) json=1 ;;
      *) file="$1" ;;
    esac
    shift
  done

  if [[ -z ${file} ]]; then
    printf 'usage: %s [--json] FILE\n' "${0##*/}" >&2
    return 64
  fi

  if [[ ! -r ${file} ]]; then
    printf '%s: cannot read %s\n' "${0##*/}" "${file}" >&2
    return 66
  fi

  local total=0 passed=0 failed=0
  local status

  while IFS=, read -r _ status _; do
    if [[ ${status} == 'status' ]]; then
      continue
    fi
    total=$((total + 1))
    case "${status}" in
      pass) passed=$((passed + 1)) ;;
      *) failed=$((failed + 1)) ;;
    esac
  done < "${file}"

  if [[ ${json} -eq 1 ]]; then
    printf '{"total":%d,"passed":%d,"failed":%d}\n' "${total}" "${passed}" "${failed}"
  else
    printf 'total=%d passed=%d failed=%d\n' "${total}" "${passed}" "${failed}"
  fi
}
